digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow routing and documentation gates
propositions: Documentation-only patchsets currently consume the full OS/Python matrix plus mutation, packaging, and other expensive jobs; the workflow needs a trusted classifier to route docs-only changes to a reduced job set.

The classifier and allowlist must execute only from trusted origin/main with the exact patchset diff as untrusted data, using fail-closed semantics (empty, malformed, or uncertain diffs select full Verify).

Current inline documentation gates must be extracted into a shared composite action without adding runner jobs to the full Verify lane, and all workflow-structure tests must follow the extracted gates.
Classifier job failure or cancellation must trigger full-route fallback jobs via always()+result gating and still block Verified, even if fallback jobs pass.
All route outputs and classifier results must be wired through vote.needs with route-aware aggregation so exactly one route executes and skipped jobs from the other route are neutral.
